args.title: Juniper Labware Newsletter Summary – Warehouse Automation 2026
args.body:
- Newsletter: "Warehouse automation in 2026" highlights rising adoption of autonomous warehouse systems, linking to a feature article and a companion piece.
- Article ("Warehouse automation in 2026"): Autonomous carts boosted pick rates by 18%, but integration with existing systems took roughly twice as long as initially planned.
- Companion piece: The biggest operational saving came from a reduction in mis-picks, reinforcing accuracy gains alongside speed improvements.
